threat_event: Company cannot show the CMMC status Prime A flows down or SP 800-171 Rev. 2 compliance under DFARS 252.204-7012, and loses new defense awards
threat_source: Contract requirement (Prime A flowdown; Phase 2 Level 2 (C3PAO) suspended 2026-07-13)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recalculated score of -65; 18 requirements not met; items that cannot sit on a POA&M (32 CFR 170.21) still open
likelihood_basis: EV-039 (Prime A CMMC notice); EV-026 (2024 self-assessment without evidence); EV-027 (records requested and not held)
existing_controls: SSP v2.0; P07 POA&M; FedRAMP-authorized enclave
treatment_plan: Fund and run the remediation roadmap in P03; readiness re-check 2027-01; voluntary C3PAO assessment window 2027-02-15 to 2027-02-26; ask Prime A which CMMC level, if any, its next solicitations will require under DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0025, Revision 3

threat_event: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing steals an engineer's session token and bulk-syncs CAD models and drawings from enclave file storage
threat_source: Foreign intelligence service or contracted cyber actor targeting aerospace suppliers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA for standard users is not phishing resistant; no alert on bulk download or unfamiliar sign-in location; logs not reviewed
likelihood_basis: EV-002 (standard users on authenticator app MFA); EV-022 (no bulk download alert); EV-017 (no alert rules or log review); EV-012 (EDR alerts in business hours)
existing_controls: MFA; compliant-device check at sign-in; EDR; 6-domain sharing allow-list
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant authenticators for all enclave users; token protection and sign-in risk policies; mass-download and new-location alerts; weekly log review; 24x7 managed detection by 2027-01-31

threat_event: SPRS score of 96 posted in 2024 overstates implementation (recalculated -65), exposing the company to contract remedies and False Claims Act liability
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Self-assessment made without evidence; not updated for 2 years
likelihood_basis: EV-026 (SPRS score 96 and self-assessment sheet); EV-025 (2024 SSP and POA&M not updated)
treatment_plan: Post corrected score and date-to-110 by 2026-09-30; annual evidence-based self-assessment; President affirms only with evidence

threat_event: CUI intercepted on the SFTP gateway or site-to-site VPN, or an export violation because encryption is not FIPS-validated
threat_source: Cyber actor on the internet path; export regulators
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: FIPS mode not confirmed on the SFTP gateway VM or plant firewall; VPN pre-shared key never rotated
likelihood_basis: EV-023 (SFTP crypto library not in FIPS mode); EV-013 (VPN FIPS mode off); EV-015 (pre-shared key never changed)
existing_controls: SSH and IPsec in use; provider-side validated modules
treatment_plan: Enable and document FIPS mode (validated module certificates) on the SFTP gateway and plant firewall; certificate-based VPN; key rotation

threat_event: A visitor, including a foreign-national employee of a commercial customer, views or photographs ITAR-controlled drawings left at machines on the shop floor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Printed drawings unmarked and left at machines; escort and visitor log inconsistent on the floor
likelihood_basis: EV-036 (drawings at machines and in open bins); EV-035 (visitor log entries blank on 11 of 30 days); EV-057 (Plant Manager interview on escort)
existing_controls: Badge access to the plant; escort rule for engineering wing
treatment_plan: Escort and log every visitor on the floor; foreign-person visit approval by the Empowered Official; cell drawing cabinets; cover or remove drawings on visit routes

threat_event: An NC program or traveler is changed through a shared MES login and the change cannot be traced to a person
threat_source: Insider or outsider on the shop-floor VLAN
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared MES terminal logins; no MFA; MES operators can edit NC programs
likelihood_basis: EV-020 (shared MES logins, no MFA, operators can edit NC programs)
existing_controls: Badge access to the plant; MES change history by shared account
treatment_plan: MES sign-in through SYS-01 with badge plus PIN; remove NC edit rights from operators; MES audit logs to the log workspace

threat_event: Printed CUI taken home or to a customer site is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written rules for printed CUI outside the plant
likelihood_basis: EV-032 (telework template has no printed CUI rule)
treatment_plan: POL-04 rules for printed CUI outside the plant; sealed envelopes and sign-out log

threat_event: A cyber incident affecting CUI is not reported to DoD within 72 hours of discovery
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No DoD-approved medium assurance certificate; no trained reporters; no drill
likelihood_basis: EV-027 (no medium assurance certificate or DIBNet records); EV-057 (Contracts Manager interview 2026-07-16)
treatment_plan: Medium assurance certificates for the Contracts Manager and IT Manager by 2026-10-31; DIBNet drill in the 2026-11-18 tabletop

threat_event: Images and logs needed by DoD are lost before the 90-day preservation period ends
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 90-day log retention; no image capture procedure; no forensic retainer
likelihood_basis: EV-017 (90-day log retention); EV-027 (no image capture procedure or forensic retainer)
existing_controls: Cloud snapshots possible; provider CRM covers provider-side forensics
treatment_plan: 1-year log retention; snapshot and imaging procedure in P08; forensic retainer by 2026-10-31

threat_event: An outside processor that received CUI drawings without DFARS flowdown is breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No DFARS 252.204-7012 or 252.204-7020 flowdown in purchase orders; supplier SPRS and CMMC status unknown
likelihood_basis: EV-040 (no DFARS clauses in 3 of 3 purchase orders); EV-041 (no SPRS or CMMC status on file)
treatment_plan: Flow down clauses; check SPRS and CMMC status before sending CUI; send only the drawing views each process needs

threat_event: Ransomware on the shop-floor VLAN encrypts the MES and DNC servers and their local backup disk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Weekly local-only backups; MES remote desktop open on the VLAN; quarterly MES patching
likelihood_basis: EV-019 (weekly local backup; remote desktop service on MES); EV-011 (quarterly MES patching); EV-012 (EDR on MES and DNC)
existing_controls: EDR on MES and DNC; enclave firewall
treatment_plan: Daily encrypted backups of MES and DNC to the cloud backup vault; close remote desktop; monthly patching; restore test in the contingency plan

threat_event: Malware reaches a CNC controller from an uncontrolled USB drive or vendor diagnostic media
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 legacy machines loaded by USB; vendor media not scanned; controllers cannot be patched
likelihood_basis: EV-036 (unlabeled USB drives; no scan step for vendor media); EV-021 (6 machines loaded by USB; controllers not patchable)
treatment_plan: Labeled and inventoried USB drives scanned at a kiosk (2026-10-31); DNC serial gateway for the 6 machines (2027-01-31); scan vendor media

threat_event: A known vulnerability in an enclave VM, workstation, or MES server is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vulnerability scanning; VMs patched manually; MES patched quarterly
likelihood_basis: EV-027 (no vulnerability scan reports); EV-011 (VM and MES patch records)
treatment_plan: Monthly authenticated scans; 30-day patch window for high findings; VM patch automation

threat_event: Engineers paste CUI into public generative AI chatbots or upload it to public file-sharing sites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineering VLAN allows any outbound traffic; no approved-tools list; generic training
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no AI or file-sharing category rule); EV-013 (engineering VLAN allows any outbound); EV-057 (3 engineers pasted CUI, 2026-07-16); EV-029 (generic training)
treatment_plan: Block public AI and file-sharing categories from enclave VLANs and desktops by 2026-10-31; approved-tools list in POL-05; CUI handling training; evaluate the enclave suite's assistant (P10)

threat_event: A departing or disgruntled engineer copies CUI to take to a competitor or foreign buyer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No insider threat training; no alert on mass download; late account disable
likelihood_basis: EV-029 (no insider threat content); EV-022 (no bulk download alert); EV-005 (no time requirement on termination notices)
treatment_plan: Insider threat module; HR-triggered same-day disable; download alerts

threat_event: An intrusion goes undetected for weeks because enclave logs are not reviewed and MES, DNC, and firewall logs are not collected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No log review; partial collection; 90-day retention; EDR alerts watched in business hours only
likelihood_basis: EV-017 (no review; no MES, DNC or firewall source; 90-day retention); EV-012 (EDR alerts in business hours); EV-057 (IT Manager interview)
treatment_plan: Collect MES, DNC, and firewall logs; weekly review with alerts; 24x7 managed detection

threat_event: An undocumented configuration change weakens enclave security (for example, a firewall rule or sharing setting)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change control; baselines not documented
likelihood_basis: EV-009 (no change tickets); EV-027 (no baselines or change procedure); EV-057 (Systems Administrators interview)
existing_controls: Only named administrators can change settings
treatment_plan: Change tickets with security review; documented baselines; quarterly drift check

threat_event: A compromised administrator session deletes backups and logs along with production data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Same two administrators run production, backup, and logging
likelihood_basis: EV-003 (same 2 administrators hold production, backup and logging roles)
existing_controls: Just-in-time role activation with hardware keys
treatment_plan: Separate log and backup role for the IT Manager; soft delete and immutability on the backup vault; alerts on break-glass use

threat_event: The C3PAO rules that the ERP holding DoD purchase order data is in scope, delaying certification
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ERP scoping position unresolved (DFARS 252.204-7021(d)(2))
likelihood_basis: EV-051 (DoD purchase order data in ERP); EV-061 (scoping workshop)
existing_controls: Drawings excluded from ERP by policy
treatment_plan: Written position from Prime A by 2026-10-31; if needed, apply Level 1 safeguards to ERP or move DoD order data

threat_event: Printed drawings put in general recycling bins are recovered by an unauthorized party
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No CUI destruction process for paper
likelihood_basis: EV-036 (general recycling bins in the cells)
treatment_plan: Locked shred bins in every cell; destruction certificates from the shredding vendor

threat_event: Business email compromise of a corporate mailbox leads to a fraudulent payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commercial email outside the enclave; generic training
likelihood_basis: EV-044 (commercial email with MFA outside the enclave); EV-029 (generic training)
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for bank changes; phishing simulations

threat_event: A wrong or altered NC program revision produces nonconforming flight parts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DNC library not checked against PLM release; operators can edit programs
likelihood_basis: EV-020 (operators can edit NC programs); EV-053 (BIA interviews on NC program revisions)
treatment_plan: Checksum check of DNC programs against PLM release; remove operator edit rights

threat_event: A regional outage at the cloud provider makes PLM and the collaboration suite unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single provider and region
likelihood_basis: EV-016 (all workloads in one region); EV-043 (provider documentation)
existing_controls: Provider availability commitments; shop floor runs on premises
treatment_plan: Accept: shop floor keeps running; engineers work locally for up to 72 h (P05 BP-03)

threat_event: The plant internet circuit fails and engineering loses access to PLM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One internet circuit at the plant
likelihood_basis: EV-013 (one internet circuit)
existing_controls: Enclave laptops work from any connection
treatment_plan: Accept for now; evaluate cellular backup router in the contingency plan

threat_event: A hurricane damages the plant or cuts power for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida location; single plant
likelihood_basis: EV-045 (property and business interruption policy); EV-056 (risk interviews on hurricane preparation)
treatment_plan: Property and business interruption insurance; hurricane preparation checklist in the contingency plan

threat_event: The corporate MSP's remote tools are compromised and used to pivot into the enclave
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP manages 170 corporate endpoints
likelihood_basis: EV-044 (MSP scope limited to 170 corporate endpoints); EV-013 (firewall allows only time sync and print release); EV-057 (MSP holds no enclave accounts)
existing_controls: MSP has no enclave accounts; enclave firewall allows only time sync and print release
treatment_plan: Accept: separation confirmed in P03 scoping; re-check firewall rules quarterly

threat_event: A machine tool vendor's remote support session is misused
threat_source: Vendor technician or attacker using vendor access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor support needed for CNC controllers
likelihood_basis: EV-046 (guest desktop with MFA; session log)
existing_controls: Guest desktop with MFA, opened on request and watched
treatment_plan: Accept: existing controls

threat_event: An enclave laptop is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops travel to customer sites
likelihood_basis: EV-010 (full-disk encryption on enrolled laptops); EV-056 (laptops taken to customer sites)
treatment_plan: Accept: existing controls

threat_event: The enclave suite's generative AI assistant surfaces CUI to users who lack need-to-know once enabled
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: File permissions in SYS-02 are broad for some project sites; the assistant searches everything a user can open
likelihood_basis: EV-022 (some project sites shared with all enclave users; assistant not enabled)
treatment_plan: Do not enable until the P10 conditions are met (permission clean-up, pilot group, logging)

threat_event: An AI-generated summary of a specification contains an error that leads to a wrong engineering decision
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No review rule for AI outputs
likelihood_basis: EV-027 (no approved AI tools list or AI output rule)
treatment_plan: Human review rule and prohibited uses in P10; outputs never used as the source for dimensions or tolerances

threat_event: Staff mishandle CUI (unmarked files, CUI sent from commercial email, wrong recipients)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generic training; no CUI marking guidance
likelihood_basis: EV-029 (generic training); EV-037 (no CUI marking on printed travelers); EV-056 (risk interviews)
treatment_plan: CUI handling and marking module for all enclave users and shop-floor leads; role-based training

threat_event: An enclave account of a departed employee is used to reach CUI
threat_source: Former employee or attacker using a stale account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Terminations are emailed to IT with no same-day rule; 2 accounts found enabled 19 and 45 days after departure
likelihood_basis: EV-AC-2 (2 accounts enabled 19 and 45 days after departure); EV-006 (termination notices by email)
existing_controls: Accounts need MFA and a compliant device
treatment_plan: HR-triggered same-day disable; monthly inactive account report; quarterly access review
